anchor_edits.instruction: Replace the current generic `cuda_cu` implementation with a refinement that preserves the existing scalar fallback kernel, warp-level reduction helper, C++ entrypoint signature, and one-block-per-sample launch structure, but changes only the vec4 fast path as follows: keep `THREADS_PER_BLOCK` at 1024; introduce exact-shape constants for the known fast path (`OUTER_EXACT = 16`, `INNER_EXACT = 4194304`, `INNER4_EXACT = 1048576`, `VEC_UNROLL = 2`, `VEC_STRIDE = THREADS_PER_BLOCK * VEC_UNROLL`); replace the generic `layernorm_fused_kernel_vec4(..., int outer, int inner4, float eps)` with an exact-shape kernel that takes only `(const float4* x4, const float4* weight4, const float4* bias4, float4* out4, float eps)` or otherwise ignores runtime `inner4`, computes `sample = blockIdx.x`, returns if `sample >= OUTER_EXACT`, and uses fixed loops `for (int i = threadIdx.x * 2; i < INNER4_EXACT; i += VEC_STRIDE)` with a guarded second load/store only if `i + 1 < INNER4_EXACT`; remove the separate generic cleanup loops because this exact shape has no remainder for the 1024-thread unroll-2 case; keep the existing warp-shuffle reduction and shared-memory cross-warp combine for sum/sumsq; in the wrapper, preserve the current `can_vec` alignment checks but add an exact-shape guard `outer == OUTER_EXACT && inner == INNER_EXACT` before launching the specialized vec4 kernel, otherwise fall back to the existing scalar kernel; do not modify `cuda_cpp` or any forward/init anchors.

phase2_n5.performance_hypothesis: Because the exact fast path always runs with `outer=16`, `inner=4194304`, `inner4=1048576`, and the champion block size of 1024 makes `inner4` an exact multiple of the unroll-2 stride, replacing the generic vec4 kernel's runtime-sized loops and zero-iteration cleanup code with an exact-size specialized steady-state loop will reduce loop/control instructions and enable better compiler scheduling, yielding a small speedup without changing memory traffic volume.
phase2_n5.single_change_focus: Specialize only the champion vec4 kernel in `cuda_cu` for the exact `inner4=1048576` case by removing generic tail/cleanup handling and using fixed-trip unroll-2 loops, while leaving the scalar fallback and dispatch structure intact.
